headline: Mondrian (class-conditional) conformal on the signed Arrhenius pot-life gate: the finite-sample category-conditional guarantee requires n>=10 held-out points PER amine class at 90% and n>=5 at 80%. At 90% ALL 5 classes are data-starved (max class has 9<10 pts) -> class-conditional 90% bands are INFINITE (G5 confirms). At 80% 4/5 classes reach a finite class-conditional band and 4/5 meet nominal; in particular aromatic-amine -- which UNDER-covered (0.778) under the prior marginal/leave-one-family-out band -- is class-conditionally valid at 80% (cov 0.888889). The marginal jackknife+ band still meets nominal (G1 PASS) and reproduces the prior signed receipt. MAPE ties to signed KPI (delta 2.8e-17).

non_circularity: The Arrhenius activation energies are external published constants (Prime 1997; Kamal & Sourour 1973; Blanco 2005), not fit to these 36 points, so the log-residuals are genuinely out-of-sample. Mondrian calibration is within-class leave-one-out; no test point informs its own band, and no cross-class leakage occurs (each class is calibrated only on itself).
nonconformity_score: s_i = |ln(pred_i) - ln(obs_i)| (multiplicative pot-life error), identical to signed marginal receipt
purpose: Answer the open Phase-1 question flagged by the signed marginal conformal receipt -- 'the CRO gate needs class-stratified intervals' -- by building the correct construction for category-conditional coverage (a Mondrian conformal predictor) on the SAME signed 12-system x 3-held-out-temperature truth table. Quantifies the per-amine-class data requirement for a finite class-conditional 90%/80% pot-life band. No new data, no model refit.
theory_reference: Mondrian / taxonomy conformal: Vovk, Lindsay, Nouretdinov & Gammerman 2003 'Mondrian Confidence Machine' (RHUL-ML tech report); Vovk, Gammerman & Shafer 2005 'Algorithmic Learning in a Random World' ch.4, Springer ISBN 978-0-387-00152-4; Bostrom, Johansson & Lofstrom 2021 'Mondrian conformal predictors', PMLR 152 (COPA). Underlying model: Arrhenius (1889) k(T)=A*exp(-Ea/RT), pot_life(T)=pot_life_ref*exp[(Ea/R)(1/T-1/T_ref)], R=8.31446261815324 J/(mol.K) CODATA 2018, T_ref=295.928 K (22.78 C).
within_system_correlation_caveat: Each system contributes 3 held-out temperatures; the 3 points share one activation energy and are correlated. Point-level exchangeability matches the prior signed receipt's convention, but the EFFECTIVE independent-unit count per class is n_systems (max 3), so class-conditional 90% coverage is even more data-starved at the system level. Reported for honesty; both counts are shown.
